name: IVR
tagline: Pan-European Association for Inland Waterway Transport Representation
hero_kpi_rationale: IVR est une association sectorielle sans données financières publiques. La participation aux congrès (225 participants en 2024) et aux comités techniques représente le principal indicateur d'activité et d'engagement des membres.

kpis.explanation: Total participants in the IVR annual congress from member countries.
kpis.signal: Strong member participation indicating active engagement and international reach across European inland waterway sector.
kpis.description: 225 participants from 11 European countries attended the IVR Annual Congress in Frankfurt am Main (May 15-17, 2024).

kpis.explanation: Number of European countries with member representation in the association.
kpis.signal: Pan-European scope demonstrating the international reach of the inland waterway representation.
kpis.description: IVR represents the interests of the inland waterway sector across 11 European countries, with documented participation at the 2024 Annual Congress.

kpis.explanation: First-ever Loss Prevention Colloquium organized by IVR attracting industry professionals.
kpis.signal: Inaugural loss prevention event demonstrating sector focus on risk management and knowledge sharing.
kpis.description: The first Loss Prevention Colloquium held in Antwerp on November 4, 2024, attracted approximately 80 participants from Belgium, Netherlands, and Germany across insurance, shipping, and legal sectors.

ai_positioning.summary: No mention of artificial intelligence, machine learning, or advanced digital technologies in the 2024 annual report. IVR's focus remains on regulatory representation, technical standardization (CESNI), loss prevention, and traditional maritime regulatory compliance for the inland waterway transport sector.
evidence: No references to AI, APIs, or machine learning capabilities.
Activities center on technical committees (CESNI), loss prevention standards, and regulatory harmonization.
Digitalization mentioned only in context of CESNI working groups on professionalization and standardization.
No mention of generative AI, data analytics platforms, or digital transformation initiatives.
